title: How to get hired as a junior in tech
description:
- What companies are actually looking for in junior talent
- Which skills can help you stand out
- Building in public
- How to get experience when every job asks for experience
- How to leverage hackathons, open source & community
- From student → contributor → first job
- Building a portfolio that gets attention
- How to approach recruiters and companies
- Common mistakes junior candidates make
abstract: Breaking into tech is harder than ever, especially for junior talent. This session will cover what companies actually look for, how to build relevant experience without a traditional job, and how to use projects, hackathons, open source and community to stand out and land your first opportunity.
